name: Left Hand Gravel Double IPA
description: First bike race! And honestly first group ride. Figured out the group dynamics and drafting pretty fast. Should have gone out faster because I was stuck in the slow mass for the first 10 miles or so. Still feel like I have plenty left in the tank, which is nice because my legs were feeling pretty toasted yesterday and this morning. New max speed: 51.1!!! Official time 03:54:01
